title: Shock Loading Accesses Reaction Pathways beyond Accelerated Thermolysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.41955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Thermolysis and shock loading can produce similar major stable products in energetic materials, despite different chemical evolution and reaction pathways. Here, we develop EMFF-MACE, a reactive machine-learning potential for C/H/N/O energetic materials, enabling thermolysis simulations of 20 materials and shock simulations of 10 on a common potential energy surface. Comparisons at matched normalized reaction progress reveal divergent chemical states and local structural environments. Mean reaction-state similarity decreases from 94.0% at 20% progress to 25.9% at trajectory endpoints, while 47.1-92.6% of shock local environments lie outside corresponding material-specific thermolysis reference domains. Structural and reaction-network analyses reveal enhanced intermolecular reorganization and additional association and rearrangement branches under shock loading, despite partially shared early decomposition chemistry. translated_title: 冲击加载可触及超越加速热解的反应路径
translated_abstract: 在含能材料中，热解和冲击加载尽管化学演化和反应路径不同，却可以产生相似的主要稳定产物。在此，我们开发了EMFF-MACE，一种面向C/H/N/O含能材料的反应性机器学习势，能够在同一势能面上对20种材料进行热解模拟、对10种材料进行冲击模拟。在匹配的归一化反应进度下进行比较，结果显示出截然不同的化学态和局部结构环境：平均反应态相似度从反应进度20%时的94.0%下降到轨迹终点时的25.9%，同时47.1-92.6%的冲击局部环境位于相应材料特定热解参考域之外。结构和反应网络分析表明，尽管早期分解化学部分相同，冲击加载下分子间重组显著增强，并出现了额外的缔合和重排反应分支。这些发现表明，冲击加载能够激活超越热解的独立反应路径。
tldr: 本研究开发了统一的反应性机器学习势EMFF-MACE，通过对比20种含能材料的热解与冲击模拟，揭示冲击加载在早期分解化学部分相似的情况下，会激活超越热解的独立反应路径，产生显著不同的化学态、局部结构和额外的缔合与重排反应分支。
en_tdlr: Using EMFF-MACE, a reactive machine-learning potential on a common potential energy surface, this work shows that shock loading of energetic materials accesses reaction pathways beyond thermolysis, producing divergent chemical states, local structural environments, and additional association/rearrangement reaction-network branches despite partially shared early decomposition chemistry.
